scope: Kayenta Obsession second-edition BASE/CORE, standard 16-round 2–4-player multiplayer, base objective deck. Marked expansions, alternate modes and optional variants excluded.

checked_claims.checked: 2–4 players, standard 16 spaces, four seasons, twelve turns per player; courtship has no service rotation, monument income, Servants’ Hall or player turns.

Draft order; five starting servants and tiles; two starter guests with unused starters returned to casual deck; five objectives; four base family bonuses; hired servant supply; selected monuments and starting market restrictions.
Village Fairs 3/9; objective draw 6; Builders’ Holiday 11; National Holiday 14; courtships 4/8/12/16.

checked_claims.checked: One-space service rotation; round event before ongoing effects; activity, exact attendees, service, favours, purchase, cleanup; passing refresh/recovery before event and benefit.
Screening level is fixed at the end of step 2; later special-action costs can reduce actual reputation without invalidating tile/guest eligibility; acquisitions and final VP are unrestricted by PR.
Increments, wheel advancement, 1.1 minimum, Max.5 storage limit, maximum-level score, minimum protection and special-action restrictions.
Borrow Money: two increments for £100; Service Help: three to move one Quarters servant; special market refresh: four, once per turn; other refresh methods independent.
Public money, unlimited supply, no player transfers; mandatory positive-before-negative sequence and fully payable money penalties, using favours, VP cards or borrowing.
Common and unique classifications; housekeeper/maid and Brushing Room/valet conditions; underbutler substitutes for base male servants even if available.

Butler’s Room is a base activity without gentry; up to two hires or upgraded recruitment from any location of an opponent’s board; underbutler exclusively through Butler’s Pantry and immediately expended.
One Quarters servant may be used each turn in addition to Available Service; distinct from special action and board area.
Hand/discard ownership and scoring; family cannot be dismissed; reveal kept screened guests only; bottom-deck dismissals from hand, activity or discard; casual respectable/unsavoury distinction.
All family favours and VP; Young Lady male-prestige condition; Asquith Dowager; Charles/Elizabeth favours, services, no PR and 8 VP; two base gossips.
Mandatory first upgrade; ongoing effects; reminders; Green Room and South Lawn alternate categories; final face-up category controls courtship and category objectives.
Barn, Private Study, Servants’ Hall, Main Library, normal and alternate West Terrace distinction, Long Gallery count reduction and other base activity refs.

Heritage doubles all favours including negatives; Queen’s doubles one; Lionheart draws prestige guest with no personal service and does not double negative favours; fixed one guest; Queen’s/Lionheart upgrade into monuments.
One reputation on later ordinary turns, including passes; no courtship income; suites cannot host again after monument conversion.
One normal purchase, price modifiers and £100 floor, duplicate acquisition prohibition, Reserve £300 base, Service and PR1 opening timings, Largest Wine Cellar exception.

checked_claims.topic: Market refill, refresh and multiple purchases
checked_claims.checked: Slide left, stack duplicates, sort only new tiles; refresh sets old market aside until replacement completed; multiple purchases use unchanged market before refill and disallow mid-purchase refresh.
Full refresh follows Reserve movement after each first-three courtship; required by selected default, corrected player-aid reference.

checked_claims.checked: Seven normal objectives less four courtship discards; extra objective increases retained count; bottom-deck discards; tile ownership rather than upgrade; every VP-card benefit and its use/discard timing.
Return Fairchild first, category tile VP including negatives, tie awards; upkeep ordering and anticlockwise marker; final four-theme scoring and reputation-level tiebreak.

important_omissions_assessment: No important omission found that changes legal base play, timing, destinations, costs, exceptions, courtship, scoring or end conditions. Ordinary tile-specific printed requirements and favours are appropriately deferred to their components rather than fully reproduced.
independence_statement: I am a fresh source auditor and did not author the summary or repairs. I audited only the designated frozen summary against the authorized primary sources. I did not read reader questions, answer keys, reader outputs, grades, prior audits or other QA reports; I did not communicate with readers and did not edit the summary. The PASS verdict was reached after checking the sources, not assumed.
